# Adding Neighbourhood Geographies
```{r}
package <- show_package("fc443770-ef0a-4025-9c2c-2cb558bfab00")
package
```

```{r}
resources <- list_package_resources("fc443770-ef0a-4025-9c2c-2cb558bfab00")
	
datastore_resources <- filter(resources, tolower(format) %in% c('csv', 'geojson'))

torontonbh <- filter(datastore_resources, row_number()==1) %>% get_resource()
```

# Adding Neighbourhood Profiles
```{r}
nbhdata <- read_xlsx("neighbourhood-profiles-2021-158-model.xlsx")
```

# Swapping Rows and Columns of Neighbourhood Profiles. Processing Columns of Interest.
```{r}
nbhdata_transpose <- data.frame(t(nbhdata[-1]))

#Renaming Columns of Interest
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "AREA_SHORT_CODE" = 1)
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "TOTAL_POPULATION" = 3)
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "EMPLOYMENT_RATE" = 1970)
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "MEDIAN_AGE" = 35)
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "MEDIAN_INCOME_2020" = 63)

#Making Columns of Interest Numeric for Analysis
nbhdata_transpose <- nbhdata_transpose %>%
  mutate(TOTAL_POPULATION = as.numeric(as.character(TOTAL_POPULATION)))
nbhdata_transpose <- nbhdata_transpose %>%
  mutate(EMPLOYMENT_RATE = as.numeric(as.character(EMPLOYMENT_RATE)))
nbhdata_transpose <- nbhdata_transpose %>%
  mutate(MEDIAN_AGE = as.numeric(as.character(MEDIAN_AGE)))
nbhdata_transpose <- nbhdata_transpose %>%
  mutate(MEDIAN_INCOME_2020 = as.numeric(as.character(MEDIAN_INCOME_2020)))
```
```{r}
nbhdata_transpose
```
# Joining nbhdata to torontonbh geometries
```{r}
torontodata <- left_join(torontonbh, nbhdata_transpose, by = "AREA_SHORT_CODE")
```
# Calculating Population Density 
```{r}
torontodata <- torontodata %>%
  mutate (AREA_SQKM = st_area(geometry))
units(torontodata$AREA_SQKM) <- "km^2"
torontodata <- torontodata %>%
  mutate(AREA_SQKM = as.numeric(as.character(AREA_SQKM)))
torontodata <- torontodata %>%
  mutate (POP_DEN = TOTAL_POPULATION/AREA_SQKM)
```
Creating Spatial Weights for Toronto
```{r}
torontodata.nb <- poly2nb(pl = torontodata)
torontodata.w <- nb2listw(torontodata.nb)
```

# Plotting Employment Rate
```{r}
Emloyment_Rate_Map <- ggplot(torontodata) + 
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cut_number(EMPLOYMENT_RATE, 5)), color = NA, size = 0.1) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  coord_sf() +
  labs(fill = "Employment Rate (%)")

Emloyment_Rate_Map

moran.test(torontodata$EMPLOYMENT_RATE, torontodata.w)
```

# Bike Share Utilization
```{r}
## Load JSON data 
bike_json <- fromJSON("https://tor.publicbikesystem.net/ube/gbfs/v1/en/station_information.json")

glimpse(bike_json) 

## Load station status 
status_json <- fromJSON("https://tor.publicbikesystem.net/ube/gbfs/v1/en/station_status.json")
status <- status_json$data$stations

glimpse(status)

## Extract Stations Table
stations <- bike_json$data$stations

## Join info + live data 
stations_full <- stations %>%
  left_join(status, by = "station_id")

glimpse(stations_full)

## Inspect Dataset
head(stations)
View(stations)
glimpse(stations)
names(stations)

## Export Raw data 
write_xlsx(stations, "stations_full_raw.xlsx")

## Clean Data
stations_clean <- stations_full %>%
  select(
    station_id,
    name,
    lat,
    lon,
    capacity,
    num_bikes_available,
    num_docks_available,
    groups
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Station_ID = station_id,
    Station_Name = name,
    Latitude = lat,
    Longitude = lon,
    Capacity = capacity,
    Bikes_Available = num_bikes_available,
    Docks_Available = num_docks_available,
    Area = groups
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Capacity))

## Fix area from list to text 
stations_clean <- stations_clean %>%
  mutate(Area = map_chr(Area, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", ")))

## Region/Neighborhood 
stations_clean <- stations_clean %>%
  separate(Area, into = c("Region", "Neighbourhood"), sep = ", ")

## Utilization of Stations 
stations_clean <- stations_clean %>%
  mutate(Utilization = (Bikes_Available / Capacity) * 100)
# Shows how full each station is (% of bikes vs total capacity)

## Timestamp of Data 
stations_clean <- stations_clean %>%
  mutate(Data_Collected = Sys.time())
## Timestamp for File Name 
timestamp <- format(max(stations_clean$Data_Collected), "%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M")

## Export Clean Data 
write_xlsx(stations_clean, "Toronto_Bikeshare_Stations.xlsx")

## Convert to Spatial Data
stations_sf <- st_as_sf(
  stations_clean,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)

## Save as GeoJSON for GIS use
st_write(stations_sf, "Toronto_Bikeshare_Stations.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)

```


```{r}
## Station Utilization Map
station_utilization_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = torontodata, colour ="black", fill= NA, alpha = 1, size = .3) +
  geom_sf(data = stations_sf, aes(color = Utilization), size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "Bike Share Station Utilization",
    subtitle = paste("Data collected:", timestamp),
    color = "Utilization (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

station_utilization_map
```
